widgets_values:
Smart Load Image: pick a file, then crop it right on the node - only the selected part goes out.
1. Pick a file in `image`, or press Upload / drop an image on the node (it goes to ComfyUI's input folder).
2. Drag on the preview to draw a crop, drag inside it to move, drag the handles to resize. `aspect_lock` keeps a ratio, `snap_to` keeps width/height on a grid (8/16/32/64 for diffusion models).
3. `⤢ Full image` removes the crop, `▣ Fit aspect` makes the largest box of the chosen ratio. The four crop_* numbers are in pixels of the original and can be typed or linked.
Outputs: IMAGE and MASK of the cropped part, its width / height, the file name.
